subject.title: Control UI fails to load on Firefox desktop behind reverse proxy — CSP blocks Vite runtime eval(), 'Control UI did not start', WebSocket 1006

question: Should this issue stay separate for Firefox/nginx reverse-proxy WebSocket proof while https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/78362 owns the CSP/Zod eval fix, or should maintainers consolidate it under the existing CSP thread now?
rationale: The CSP root cause has an open canonical thread, but this report also includes a distinct Firefox HTTPS reverse-proxy 1006 symptom that may need live proof before a security-sensitive gateway change is safe.

options.title: Keep Separate Pending Live Proof
options.body: Keep this issue open for Firefox/nginx proof while the strict-CSP Zod fix proceeds under the existing CSP thread.

options.title: Fold Into CSP Thread
options.body: Treat the WebSocket 1006 as likely startup fallout from the CSP failure and consolidate all remaining work under https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/78362.

options.title: Accept Unsafe-Eval Downgrade
options.body: Allow full unsafe-eval in Control UI CSP, but this trades away a current security guardrail and should require explicit maintainer security approval.

recommendation.title: Keep Separate Pending Live Proof
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open for Firefox/nginx proof while the strict-CSP Zod fix proceeds under the existing CSP thread.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest history across the locked-down Control UI CSP, bootstrap contract, and gateway connect behavior involved in this decision.
